topic: Workshop: Automating geotechnical reports with n8n
post_text:
Most geotechnical firms lose 12+ hours per week to report formatting alone.

We just ran a hands-on workshop showing engineers how to reclaim that time — using n8n to auto-generate borehole logs, soil classification tables, and summary memos directly from raw field data.

No coding required. The workflow connects your pXRF outputs, lab CSVs, and GIS layers into formatted Word/PDF reports in under 60 seconds. One attendee cut their reporting cycle from 3 days to 3 hours.

If your team is still copy-pasting tables by hand, you're not just slow — you're exposed to transcription errors that creep into site safety decisions.

Automation isn't the future of geotech. It's the standard.
